body:
## What happened

REGRESSION seen on commit `17ae56d34` (`staging-20260921-17ae56d3496f`) on 2026-09-21. Lane C, `one_figure_on_every_spend_surface`, interrupted a streaming turn and observed:

```text
the /spend place says $0.0001 and Settings→Spending's `today` says $0.0007 — one machine, one day, two numbers (issue #269)
```

The settings screen showed:

```text
today                                                           $0.0007 of $500 · resets at midnight
per conversation                                                         no limit · this one $0.0007
```

A rerun showed `/spend` `$0.0001`, Settings `today` `$0.0001`, and `this one` `$0.0000`. On v0.3.0 (`9258f7052`), all three read `$0.0009`.

## Replication

**Deterministic (no model).**

No no-model reproduction is established. Run the focused end-to-end gate:

```sh
go test -tags e2e -count=1 -v ./internal/e2e -run '^TestTUIE2E/one_figure_on_every_spend_surface$'
```

Today it exits nonzero when the `/spend` total, Settings `today`, and Settings `this one` fields diverge after interruption.

**Field (real models).**

Set `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`; allow about two minutes and less than $0.03. The subtest interrupts a live streaming answer, opens `/spend`, then Settings → Spending without starting a task. The v0.3.0 run is the control.

## Where

The three read paths are `readSpendLines` and `usageSince` in `internal/tui3/place_spend.go`, `readDayCost` and `spentThisSessionUSD` in `internal/tui3/settingspend.go`, and `readTreeSpend` and `treeLines` in `internal/tui3/treespend.go`. `docs/changes/unreleased/1280-a-runs-dollars-reach-the-conversations-total.md`, `1281-a-run-is-handed-what-is-left-of-every-dollar-limit.md`, and `1285-a-flush-says-whether-it-drained.md` were checked; the report says they are not the cause.

## The fix

After an interrupted stream has settled, `/spend`, Settings `today`, and Settings `this one` must read from a settled accounting view and show one figure for the same conversation and day. Opening one surface must not be required to update another.

## Acceptance

- **e2e:** Through `TestTUIE2E/one_figure_on_every_spend_surface`, interrupt a streaming turn, capture the `/spend` total and the Settings `today` and `this one` fields, assert all three dollar strings are identical, and exit 0.
- **e2e:** Through the same tmux door without interruption, assert those three named fields remain identical after a completed turn.
- **Unit:** Given one settled usage receipt, `usageSince`, `readDayCost`, and `spentThisSessionUSD` round and format the same dollar value.
- The manual page `internal/manual/chat/models-and-cost.md` says the three named surfaces use the same settled total, and the change entry's `invalidates` names the old belief that each surface may settle independently.

---
Filed from the 2026-09-21 staging verification of 17ae56d34; the lane reports, frames and e2e logs are in the owner's handoff folder for this promotion.

comments.body:
**Classification:** `bug`, `area:chat`, `sev:serious` → milestone **Reliable agent**.

- `area:chat` — all three read paths are tui3 (`place_spend.go`, `settingspend.go`, `treespend.go`); the fix is reading one settled accounting view.
- `sev:serious` — three money figures that disagree after an ordinary interrupt.
- **Reliable agent** — "spend that match reality" is literally that milestone's bar, even though the disagreeing surfaces are chat.
